company.shortDescription: Armature is a wireframing extension for Adobe Illustrator.
company.description:
Armature is a wireframing extension for Adobe Illustrator. It contains collections of commonly used objects when building wireframes and UIs for websites, web, and mobile apps. Objects are accessed by browsing or searching then double-clicking or dragging to an active artboard.

Armature is compatible with Adobe Illustrator CS5+, CC, and CC 2014 on Mac or PC.

productsAndServices.description: A wireframing extension for Adobe Illustrator providing a library of UI elements for designing user interfaces, especially for games and apps.
